title: Adequacy of Places for Home Care and Centre-based Care Services for Elderly
what_it_is: Adequacy of Places for Home Care and Centre-based Care Services for Elderly

sections.label: Home and day care capacity
sections.summary: MOH has expanded home and centre-based care capacity and is on track to meet 2020 targets.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) has been working to expand home and centre-based care capacity to better support our seniors to age-in-place among their family and friends.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We currently have a capacity of 6,900 home care and 3,500 centre-based day care places.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This is an increase of 80% from the 3,800 home care places, and a 67% increase from the 2,100 daycare places, in 2011.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We are on track to meet our target of 10,000 home care places and 6,200 daycare places by 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In 2015, the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) received home care referrals for about 8,500 seniors, and day care referrals for about 7,800 seniors.

sections.label: Referrals admitted into service
sections.summary: In 2015, about 5,600 home care and slightly more than 3,000 daycare referrals were admitted.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In 2015, of the referrals received, about 5,600 home care referrals and slightly more than 3,000 daycare referrals were admitted into service.

sections.label: No wait time for home care
sections.summary: There is no wait time for home care, with a median waiting time of about 20 days.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Taking all these into consideration as well as the fact that we have been ramping up capacity, there is no wait time for home care.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The median waiting time is about 20 days.

sections.label: Ramping up day care supply
sections.summary: Demand for day care places is increasing, and supply is being ramped up to meet 2020 targets.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Of course, there has also been increasing demand for day care places.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But let me assure Members that we are working very hard to ramp up our supply of home and day care places, and we are on track to meet our target for 2020.
